# PLMR

> Technical project solutions, drawing support, Türkiye-based supplier coordination and company-specific software workflows for outdoor systems.

PLMR is led by Aytuğ Kılınç, a civil engineer based in Türkiye.
Project scope, deliverables, responsibilities, timing and fees are agreed per enquiry.
System descriptions and illustrative deliverables are not evidence of completed client projects, manufacturing capacity or product certification.

## Services and contact
- [Engineering support](https://plmr.solutions/engineering-services): project-specific solutions, outsourced drawings, custom details and coordination.
- [Technical sourcing](https://plmr.solutions/technical-sourcing-turkey): supplier search, existing-supplier coordination, agreed visits, order follow-up and documentation checks.
- [Components](https://plmr.solutions/custom-components-solutions): project-specific aluminium and steel component requirements.
- [Example deliverables](https://plmr.solutions/example-deliverables): explicitly illustrative review, drawing and sourcing outlines.
- [Outdoor systems](https://plmr.solutions/outdoor-systems): system families and project considerations.
- [Technical insights](https://plmr.solutions/technical-insights): project preparation and system selection articles.
- [About PLMR](https://plmr.solutions/about): background and working approach.
- [Contact](https://plmr.solutions/contact): project enquiry form with reference-image attachments and file-sharing links, plus direct email and a downloadable project brief.
- [Privacy](https://plmr.solutions/privacy): project correspondence and technical data.

Business email: aytugkilinc@plmrsolutions.com
Pülümür Automation Studio is working, actively developed software. Product and output scope are agreed per company; implementation scope is defined per company.

- [Automation Studio](https://plmr.solutions/software): company-specific configuration, drawings, quotations and agreed technical outputs.

## Practical sourcing guide
- [Comparing supplier quotations](https://plmr.solutions/technical-insights/comparing-outdoor-system-quotations): a method for recording scope, evidence, exclusions and unanswered questions.


## Roof projects and concrete outputs
- [Rolling roof systems](https://plmr.solutions/rolling-roof-systems): retractable panel movement, drainage and project interfaces.
- [Custom-detail example](https://plmr.solutions/example-deliverables#custom-detail): explicitly illustrative connection-detail assignment.
- [Order follow-up example](https://plmr.solutions/example-deliverables#order-follow-up): explicitly illustrative document and packing-information review.
- [Software demonstration](https://plmr.solutions/software#demo): supplied recording from a demonstration build, not a current application source audit.

Software customer commercial information is not used for PLMR's separate sourcing or supply activity.
Module coverage, output formats, integration, licensing and support are scoped per implementation.
Rolling-roof integration and wider manufacturing connections are continuing development directions.

## Expanded architectural and material scope (v17)
- [Aluminum and building materials](https://plmr.solutions/aluminum-building-materials): profiles, sheet and coil, architectural joinery, facade components, composite panels, sandwich panels and associated materials. Brand-specific sourcing enquiries can include ASAŞ, AKPA, ALUMIL and Çuhadaroğlu.
- [Supplier quality control](https://plmr.solutions/supplier-quality-control-turkey): agreed visits, accessible sampled measurements, finish, accessories, quantities, packing and document follow-up with new or existing suppliers.
- [Lift and slide](https://plmr.solutions/lift-and-slide-systems): Hebeschiebe doors, profiles, glazing, hardware and threshold coordination.
- [Insulated windows and doors](https://plmr.solutions/insulated-aluminum-windows-doors): thermally broken aluminum joinery and supplier support.
Rolling and retractable roof requests are grouped under /rolling-roof-systems; fabric and rigid-panel mechanisms remain explicit.
New system and sourcing pages do not imply corresponding software module coverage.
New product images are original AI-generated PLMR concept illustrations, not completed-project photographs or evidence of manufacturer affiliation.
